notes: holdCapacity is what a full-sized storage holds. A smaller storage holds a permille fraction of it, which is one number per storage instead of a table revisited every time an item is added.

items.label: Matter Mix
items.notes: What missions recover: one bulk material with a composition profile, rather than a dozen ores. GDD 5.8 - it is what makes a reactor's processing mode a decision instead of a formality.

items.label: Hydrogen
items.notes: What the emergency extractor gathers, and the only material the vessel can make without a mission.

items.label: Technical Materials
items.notes: The reactors' standardized outputs. Rare Metals, Chemical Feedstock and Phase Materials are named by the GDD and absent here: no schematic on this vessel consumes them, and an item nothing produces or consumes is a row of zeroes on every storage panel.
